<1>How it stays safe.</1> Your browser m: <1>How it stays safe.</1> Your browser makes a secret number and sends the server only the matching <2>public</2> key. The server searches for an offset that makes the address start with your text and sends the offset back. Your browser adds the offset to its secret — that sum is your private key. The server never had the secret, so it cannot compute or steal the key, and your browser checks the answer before accepting it.
